title: Complex Hessian equations
summary: Spectral functions over RCLike 𝕜 (Lewis derivative, Spruck concavity), Gårding cones and admissible pairs with the structural condition, the equation f(λ[χ + i∂∂̄φ]) = c e^F on compact Hermitian manifolds with uniqueness by the comparison principle, Yau's theorem on compact Kähler manifolds (continuity method with Calabi's third-order estimate), the uniform exponential integrability of quasi-plurisubharmonic functions, and the Guo–Phong–Tong L^∞ estimates on fixed and degenerating Kähler backgrounds.

targets.name: relEigenvalues
targets.statement: For a Hermitian form a on a finite-dimensional inner product space E over RCLike 𝕜 of dimension n, the representing self-adjoint operator A_a with a(u,v) = ⟪u, A_a v⟫ and the decreasingly sorted eigenvalue vector λ[a] = λ(A_a) ∈ ℝⁿ; a ≤ b means A_a ≤ A_b in the Loewner order. Monotonicity and Lipschitz continuity of λ are consumed from OperatorTheory/PolarDecomposition PD-A52 and PD-A53.
hypotheses: E finite-dimensional inner product space over RCLike 𝕜

api.name: relEigenvalues_lipschitz

targets.name: kyFan_differentiable
targets.statement: For T self-adjoint and 1 ≤ m ≤ n, the Ky Fan sum κ_m(T) = Σ_{i≤m} λ_i(T) is convex and subadditive; it equals max Re tr(PT) over rank-m orthogonal projections (MAJ-A27 evaluated on orthonormal bases of ranges); if λ_m(T) > λ_{m+1}(T) then the spectral projection P_T onto the top m eigenvectors is the unique maximizer and κ_m is differentiable at T with gradient P_T. The two-sided trace inequality Σ γ_i μ_i ≤ Re tr(FB) ≤ Σ γ_i μ_{n+1−i} (γ decreasing eigenvalues of F, μ increasing eigenvalues of B) is recorded as PA-B32 applied to (F,B) and (F,−B).
hypotheses: F, B, T self-adjoint on a finite-dimensional inner product space over RCLike 𝕜
spectral gap λ_m(T) > λ_{m+1}(T) for the uniqueness and differentiability clauses (vacuous for m = n)

locator.where: line 145–148 and Theorem 2.1, line 150–158; spruck2005 Lemma 1.5, line 11089–11091 for the lower trace bound

targets.name: spectralFunction
targets.statement: For an open permutation-invariant Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ and a symmetric f : Ω → ℝ, the spectral domain Sym_Ω(E) = {T self-adjoint : λ(T) ∈ Ω}, open in the real space of self-adjoint operators because λ is continuous (PD-A53), and the spectral function F_f(T) = f(λ(T)) on it.
hypotheses: Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open and invariant under permutations

api.name: spectralFunction_diag

targets.name: hasFDerivAt_spectralFunction_iff

targets.name: spectralFunction_concave_elliptic

hypotheses: f : Γ → ℝ symmetric and C¹
∂_i f ≥ 0 on Γ for the monotonicity inequality; ∂_i f > 0 on Γ for its strictness clause

For symmetric p hyperbolic in e the cone contains Γ_n and lies in Γ_1. Hence Γ_k is convex and σ_k^{1/k} is concave on Γ_k with ∂_i σ_k > 0; on self-adjoint operators T ↦ σ_k(λ(T)) is hyperbolic in Id with cone Sym_{Γ_k}.

layers.title: The equation on a compact Hermitian manifold

targets.name: relEigenvalueFun
targets.statement: For a complex manifold X with Hermitian metric ω (a TauCeti.SmoothTwoForm compatible with J) and a continuous real (1,1)-form α, x ↦ λ_ω[α](x) = λ[H_{α,x}] relative to h_x, where H_α(u,v) = α(u,Jv) + iα(u,v) and h = H_ω.

Ky Fan's maximum principle: Σ Re⟪Sw_i,w_i⟫ over an orthonormal family of k vectors is at most the sum of the k largest eigenvalues

type calculus and metric conventions, ∂ and ∂̄ on smooth forms, Chern connections and curvature, Laplace-type L² elliptic theory and spectral decomposition, Kähler metrics, normal coordinates and Δ_d = 2Δ_∂̄
Hölder spaces C^{k,α} on compact bases; Schauder regularity and Fredholm theory for smooth-coefficient elliptic operators
mean value inequality, Hopf strong maximum principle, interior Schauder estimates with Hölder coefficients, weak Harnack inequality for supersolutions (gap)
forms, d, integration and Stokes, laplaceBeltrami and Riemannian volume

gaps.title: Weak Harnack inequality for nonnegative supersolutions
gaps.detail: r^{−m}‖u‖_{L¹(B_{2r})} ≤ C(inf_{B_r} u + r^{2−m/q}‖f‖_{L^q(B_{4r})}), q > m/2, for nonnegative weak supersolutions of divergence-form uniformly elliptic equations with bounded measurable coefficients (gilbarg-trudinger2001 Theorem 8.18); used on coordinate balls for −φ with Δ_ω φ ≥ −A on Kähler manifolds.
gaps.needs: the weak Harnack inequality r^{−m}‖u‖_{L¹(B_{2r})} ≤ C(inf_{B_r} u + r^{2−m/q}‖f‖_{L^q(B_{4r})}), q > m/2, for nonnegative weak supersolutions u of divergence-form uniformly elliptic equations Lu ≤ f with bounded measurable coefficients on balls of ℝ^m
